focus: Inside the city of Miami: Downtown and Overtown, Edgewater, Wynwood and northwest Miami, Little Havana along Calle Ocho, and the Coconut Grove side of US-1
intro: These Miami listings were checked on Public Storage’s own facility pages on November 24, 2026, and cover all ten Public Storage locations the operator lists for the city of Miami — Downtown and Overtown, Edgewater, Wynwood, northwest Miami along NW 21st and NW 38th Streets, Little Havana, and the Coconut Grove side of US-1. We copied published access hours and office hours separately, and we only flag climate control when the facility’s own page lists it (9 of the ten do). None of these facilities published around-the-clock access hours: 6 pages show a “24/7 Access Available” badge, but eight access-hours tables are 6:00 AM–10:00 PM daily and the two remaining downtown and Little Havana tables close at 6:00 PM on weekdays and 5:00 PM on weekends, so we recorded the tables and noted the badge. This is a starting sample from one operator, not a citywide inventory; other operators such as CubeSmart and Extra Space are not included yet, and Miami Beach, Coral Gables, Hialeah, Doral, Kendall, and the rest of Miami-Dade are not covered. We do not cache live unit prices or vacancy.
